title: Firewall Allow Rule for Vendor Monitoring
summary: Allow a vendor monitoring service to reach a restricted management endpoint from two external IP ranges.
mitigation: Limit the rule to vendor-owned IP ranges, require logging on the rule, and confirm the destination port with Security before the window.
rollback_plan: Disable the new rule object and restore the previous firewall policy package if monitoring traffic behaves unexpectedly.
audit_trail: Change ticket opened with vendor IP ranges.
Security requested logging and port validation.

title: DNS Cutover for Student Portal
summary: Move the student portal hostname to the new load balancer before morning registration traffic begins.
mitigation: Lower TTL before the window, verify the load balancer health checks, and prepare communications for the help desk.
rollback_plan: Restore the previous DNS target and keep both load balancers online until traffic returns to the prior endpoint.
audit_trail: App Owner approved the cutover plan.

title: Privileged Access Update for Admin Group
summary: Add two operators to a privileged directory group for after-hours server maintenance.
mitigation: Use temporary group membership, require manager approval, and verify MFA enrollment before granting access.
rollback_plan: Remove the two accounts from the privileged group and confirm access is revoked in the audit view.
audit_trail: Security blocked the change until MFA evidence is attached.
Owner asked for an automatic removal time.

title: Linux Patch Window for Web Servers
summary: Apply operating system security updates to the web server pool behind the registration service.
mitigation: Patch one node at a time, drain it from the load balancer, and confirm service health before moving to the next node.
rollback_plan: Stop the patch sequence, keep unpatched nodes serving traffic, and restore the patched node from the latest snapshot if needed.
audit_trail: Patch list attached to the change ticket.
App Owner confirmed acceptable maintenance window.

title: Web App Deployment for Registration Service
summary: Deploy a new registration service build that updates form validation and error handling.
mitigation: Deploy during lower traffic, run smoke tests immediately after release, and monitor error rates for the first hour.
rollback_plan: Redeploy the previous build artifact and clear the application cache if smoke tests fail.
audit_trail: Deployment notes drafted from the release checklist.
Security confirmed no new privileged permissions.
App Owner requested final smoke-test steps.

title: SSH Hardening Config for Bastion Host
summary: Disable password authentication and keep key-based SSH access for the administrative bastion host.
mitigation: Confirm all required operators have working keys and keep an active console session during the config reload.
rollback_plan: Restore the previous SSH daemon configuration from backup and reload the service through the console session.
